name: @zyncbase/client
description: Realtime TypeScript client for ZyncBase: schema-validated store, subscriptions, presence, and actions over WebSocket.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build --root src src/index.ts src/yjs/index.ts src/yjs/compactor.ts --outdir dist --format esm --splitting --external yjs && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist && bun build cli/generate.ts --outdir dist/cli --format esm --target node && bun build src/react/index.ts --outdir dist/react --format esm --external react --banner '"use client";'
